```{r fun}
get_time_params <- function(model, data,
                            var1 = "MONTHS_6TO22",
                            var2 = "MONTHS_23TO30",
                            end = c("max", "last_obs")) {
  end <- match.arg(end)
  
  coefs <- coef(model)
  
  if (!all(c(var1, var2) %in% names(coefs))) {
    stop("Time variables ", var1, " and/or ", var2,
         " are not in the model coefficients. ",
         "Make sure they weren't removed by stepwise selection.")
  }
  
  b1 <- unname(coefs[var1])
  b2 <- unname(coefs[var2])
  
  rate1 <- exp(b1) - 1
  rate2 <- exp(b2) - 1
  
  # pick the end-month exponents
  if (!all(c(var1, var2) %in% names(data))) {
    stop("Columns ", var1, " and/or ", var2,
         " not found in the data used for time params.")
  }
  
  if (end == "max") {
    # use max values across data (rough analogue to "latest month")
    m1_end <- max(data[[var1]], na.rm = TRUE)
    m2_end <- max(data[[var2]], na.rm = TRUE)
  } else if (end == "last_obs") {
    # use the last observation in time
    idx_last <- which.max(data[["MONTHS"]])  # assumes MONTHS exists too
    m1_end <- data[[var1]][idx_last]
    m2_end <- data[[var2]][idx_last]
  }
  
  end_index <- (1 + rate1)^m1_end * (1 + rate2)^m2_end
  
  list(
    b1        = b1,
    b2        = b2,
    RATE1     = rate1,
    RATE2     = rate2,
    M6TO22_end = m1_end,
    M23TO30_end = m2_end,
    END_INDEX = end_index
  )
}
```

```{r data_import}
# ---- 1. Load data & normalize names ----
df <- read_csv(here("data", "salesSFapr2023toMarch2025Updated.csv")) |>
  rename_with(toupper)    # clean_names()
```

```{r dataorg1}
############################################################
# PART A: SPSS REGRESSION PREP FOR LN_SPPSF
############################################################

# ---- 2. Restrict to SINGLE FAMILY / 1/2 DUPLEX and dedupe ----

df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    # SRESB_STYLE should be in the .sav; adjust if named slightly differently
    IN_STYLE = if_else(SRESB_STYLE %in% c("SINGLE FAMILY", "1/2 DUPLEX"), 1L, 0L)
  ) %>%
  filter(IN_STYLE == 1L) %>%
  select(-IN_STYLE)

# De-duplicate by PARCELNO, SALEPRICE, SALEDATE (keep last per group)
df <- df %>%
  arrange(PARCELNO, SALEPRICE, SALEDATE) %>%
  group_by(PARCELNO, SALEPRICE, SALEDATE) %>%
  mutate(
    PRIMARY_LAST = as.integer(row_number() == n())
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(PRIMARY_LAST == 1L) %>%
  select(-PRIMARY_LAST)

# ---- 3. Remove non-market sales (PRICE ≈ ASSESSMENT) ----

# AVWHENSOLD should be in the .sav; if not, update this field name
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    PRICEISASMT_RATIO  = AVWHENSOLD / SALEPRICE,
    PRICEISASMT_RATIO2 = PRICEISASMT_RATIO,
    PRICEISASMT_RATIO2 = if_else(
      PRICEISASMT_RATIO >= 0.90 & PRICEISASMT_RATIO <= 1.10,
      1, PRICEISASMT_RATIO2
    ),
    PRICEISASMT_RATIO = PRICEISASMT_RATIO2,
    PRICEISASMT       = if_else(PRICEISASMT_RATIO == 1, 0L, 1L)
  ) %>%
  filter(PRICEISASMT == 1L) %>%
  select(-PRICEISASMT_RATIO2)

# ---- 4. Basic outlier filters ----

# sTOTALSQFT, SRESB_FLOORAREA, SALEPRICE should all exist
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    OUT = 0L,
    OUT = if_else(STOTALSQFT < 400, 1L, OUT),
    OUT = if_else(SRESB_FLOORAREA < 400, 1L, OUT),
    OUT = if_else(SALEPRICE < 10000, 1L, OUT)
  ) %>%
  filter(OUT == 0L) %>%
  select(-OUT)

# ---- 5. SPPSF & LN_SPPSF ----

df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    SPPSF    = SALEPRICE / SRESB_FLOORAREA,
    LN_SPPSF = log(SPPSF)
  )
```

```{r dataorg2}
############################################################
# 6–15: DUMMIES / TRANSFORMS MATCHING SPSS
############################################################

# ---- 6. Story & style dummies ----

df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    ONESTORY = if_else(SRESB_STYHGT <= 2, 1L, 0L),
    TWOSTORY = if_else(SRESB_STYHGT > 2 & SRESB_STYHGT <= 5, 1L, 0L),
    
    SINGLE_FAMILY1STORY = if_else(
      SRESB_STYLE == "SINGLE FAMILY" & ONESTORY == 1L, 1L, 0L
    ),
    # SINGLE_FAMILY2STORY is base (no dummy created)
    HALF_DUPLEX1STORY = if_else(
      SRESB_STYLE == "1/2 DUPLEX" & ONESTORY == 1L, 1L, 0L
    ),
    HALF_DUPLEX2STORY = if_else(
      SRESB_STYLE == "1/2 DUPLEX" & TWOSTORY == 1L, 1L, 0L
    )
  )

# ---- 7. Year-built eras & dummies ----

df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    ERABUILT = case_when(
      SRESB_YEARBUILT < 1910 ~ 1L,
      SRESB_YEARBUILT >= 1910 & SRESB_YEARBUILT < 1930 ~ 2L,
      SRESB_YEARBUILT >= 1930 & SRESB_YEARBUILT < 1946 ~ 3L,
      SRESB_YEARBUILT >= 1946 & SRESB_YEARBUILT < 1961 ~ 4L,
      SRESB_YEARBUILT >= 1961 & SRESB_YEARBUILT <= 1990 ~ 5L,
      SRESB_YEARBUILT > 1990 ~ 6L,
      TRUE ~ 0L
    ),
    YB_PRE_1929     = if_else(ERABUILT %in% c(1L, 2L), 1L, 0L),
    YB_1946_TO_1960 = if_else(ERABUILT == 4L, 1L, 0L),
    YB_POST_1961    = if_else(ERABUILT %in% c(5L, 6L), 1L, 0L)
  )

# ---- 8. Condition dummies (GOOD, FAIR, POOR, VERY_POOR_UNSOUND) ----
# SCOND: base == 3 (Average)

df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    GOOD              = if_else(SCOND == 2, 1L, 0L, missing = 0L),
    FAIR              = if_else(SCOND == 4, 1L, 0L, missing = 0L),
    POOR              = if_else(SCOND == 5, 1L, 0L, missing = 0L),
    VERY_POOR_UNSOUND = if_else(SCOND %in% c(6, 7), 1L, 0L, missing = 0L)
  )

# ---- 9. Bathrooms dummies ----

df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    TWO_PLUS_BATHS = if_else(SRESB_FULLBATHS >= 2, 1L, 0L, missing = 0L),
    POWDER_ROOM    = if_else(SRESB_HALFBATHS >= 1 & SRESB_HALFBATHS <= 5,
                             1L, 0L, missing = 0L)
  )

# ---- 10. Fireplace dummy ----

df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    FIREPLACE = if_else(SRESB_FIREPLACE %in% 1:6, 1L, 0L, missing = 0L)
  )

# ---- 11. Quality dummies ----

df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    QABOVE_AVG      = if_else(SRESB_BLDGCLASS %in% c(3,4,5), 1L, 0L, missing = 0L),
    QBELOW_AVG_POOR = if_else(SRESB_BLDGCLASS %in% c(0,1),   1L, 0L, missing = 0L)
    # SRESB_BLDGCLASS == 2 is base
  )

# ---- 12. Basement / crawl / slab ----
# Needs SRESB_CRAWSPACE, SRESB_SLABAREA, SRESB_GROUNDAREA, SRESB_BASEMENTAREA

df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    PCTCRAWL = SRESB_CRAWSPACE    / SRESB_GROUNDAREA,
    PCTSLAB  = SRESB_SLABAREA     / SRESB_GROUNDAREA,
    PCTBSMNT = SRESB_BASEMENTAREA    / SRESB_GROUNDAREA,
    CRAWL    = if_else(PCTCRAWL > PCTBSMNT & PCTCRAWL > PCTSLAB, 1L, 0L, missing = 0L),
    SLAB     = if_else(PCTSLAB  > PCTCRAWL & PCTSLAB  > PCTBSMNT, 1L, 0L, missing = 0L)
    # BASEMENT is base
  )

# ---- 13. Garage spaces ----

df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    GARAGESPACES = case_when(
      SRESB_GARAGEAREA > 200 & SRESB_GARAGEAREA < 420 ~ 1L,
      SRESB_GARAGEAREA > 419 & SRESB_GARAGEAREA < 600 ~ 2L,
      SRESB_GARAGEAREA > 599 & SRESB_GARAGEAREA < 820 ~ 3L,
      SRESB_GARAGEAREA > 819                          ~ 4L,
      TRUE ~ 0L
    ),
    LN_GARAGESPACES = if_else(GARAGESPACES > 0L, log(GARAGESPACES), NA_real_)
  )

# ---- 14. Street class & heating/cooling ----

df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    ARTERIAL   = if_else(RD_CLASS == "A31", 1L, 0L, missing = 0L),
    HOT_WATER  = if_else(SRESB_HEAT == 2, 1L, 0L, missing = 0L),
    CENTRAL_AIR = if_else(SRESB_HEAT == 9, 1L, 0L, missing = 0L)
  )

# ---- 15. Size buckets ----

df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    SIZE = case_when(
      SRESB_FLOORAREA < 830 ~ 1L,
      SRESB_FLOORAREA >= 830  & SRESB_FLOORAREA < 1018 ~ 2L,
      SRESB_FLOORAREA >= 1018 & SRESB_FLOORAREA < 1255 ~ 3L,
      SRESB_FLOORAREA >= 1255 & SRESB_FLOORAREA < 1632 ~ 4L,
      SRESB_FLOORAREA >= 1632 ~ 5L,
      TRUE ~ 0L
    ),
    SMALLEST = if_else(SIZE == 1L, 1L, 0L),
    SMALL    = if_else(SIZE == 2L, 1L, 0L),
    LARGE    = if_else(SIZE == 4L, 1L, 0L),
    LARGEST  = if_else(SIZE == 5L, 1L, 0L)
    # SIZE == 3 is base
  )

############################################################
# 16. Time variables + SCOND filter (AVERAGE)
############################################################

df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    SMONTH = month(SALEDATE),
    SYEAR  = year(SALEDATE),
    MONTHS = case_when(
      SYEAR == 2022 ~ SMONTH + 0L,
      SYEAR == 2023 ~ SMONTH + 12L,
      SYEAR == 2024 ~ SMONTH + 24L,
      TRUE          ~ NA_integer_
    ),
    AVERAGE = if_else(SCOND == 4, 1L, 0L, missing = 0L)
  ) %>%
  filter(AVERAGE == 1L) %>%
  mutate(
    MONTHS_6TO22  = MONTHS,
    MONTHS_6TO22  = if_else(MONTHS > 22L, 22L, MONTHS_6TO22),
    MONTHS_23TO30 = if_else(MONTHS > 22L, MONTHS - 22L, 0L)
  )
```

```{r mod1}
############################################################
# 17. LN_SPPSF full model + backward elimination
############################################################

mod_ln_sppsf_full <- lm(
  LN_SPPSF ~ ARTERIAL +
    SINGLE_FAMILY1STORY +
    HALF_DUPLEX1STORY + HALF_DUPLEX2STORY +
    SMALLEST + SMALL + LARGE + LARGEST +
    TWO_PLUS_BATHS + POWDER_ROOM +
    GOOD + FAIR + POOR + VERY_POOR_UNSOUND +
    QABOVE_AVG + QBELOW_AVG_POOR +
    YB_PRE_1929 + YB_1946_TO_1960 + YB_POST_1961 +
    CRAWL + SLAB +
    LN_GARAGESPACES + FIREPLACE +
    HOT_WATER + CENTRAL_AIR +
    MONTHS_6TO22 + MONTHS_23TO30,
  data = df
)

# SPSS-style backward by p-value
mod_ln_sppsf_back <- ols_step_backward_p(
  model   = mod_ln_sppsf_full,
  pent    = 0.05,
  prem    = 0.10,
  details = FALSE
)$model

summary(mod_ln_sppsf_full)
summary(mod_ln_sppsf_back)

# Number of observations in the model
n_mod <- nobs(mod_ln_sppsf_back)

# Get the rows from df that were actually used in the model
mf <- model.frame(mod_ln_sppsf_back)
idx <- as.integer(rownames(mf))  # row indices in df

# Work only on those rows
df_in <- df[idx, ] %>%
  mutate(
    COOK_1 = cooks.distance(mod_ln_sppsf_back),
    SDR_1  = rstandard(mod_ln_sppsf_back),
    IN_FLAG = if_else(
      COOK_1 <= 4 / n_mod & abs(SDR_1) <= 2,
      1L, 0L
    )
  )
# After filtering outliers
df_in <- df_in %>% filter(IN_FLAG == 1L)

# ---- 20. First time adjustment (RATE1 & RATE2 set #1) ----
time_params <- get_time_params(mod_ln_sppsf_back, df_in, end = "max")
# $b1, $b2           # raw coefficients
# $RATE1, $RATE2     # per-month rates
# $M6TO22_end, $M23TO30_end
# $END_INDEX

RATE1     <- time_params$RATE1
RATE2     <- time_params$RATE2
END_INDEX <- time_params$END_INDEX

df_in <- df_in %>%
  mutate(
    PRICE_INDEX = (1 + RATE1)^MONTHS_6TO22 * (1 + RATE2)^MONTHS_23TO30,
    TAF        = END_INDEX / PRICE_INDEX,
    TASP       = SALEPRICE * TAF,
    TASPPSF    = TASP / SRESB_FLOORAREA,
    LN_TASP    = log(TASP)
  )
```

```{r mod1a}
############################################################
# 18. Diagnostics & ggplot charts for LN_SPPSF model
############################################################

# 1) Get the rows that were actually used by the model
mf <- model.frame(mod_ln_sppsf_back)          # model frame
row_idx <- as.integer(rownames(mf))           # row numbers in df

# 2) Subset df to those rows and augment
aug_sppsf <- augment(mod_ln_sppsf_back, data = df[row_idx, ]) %>%
  mutate(
    # back-transform from log if LN_SPPSF = log(SPPSF)
    PRED_SPPSF = exp(.fitted),
    STD_RESID  = .std.resid
  )

# 3) Histogram of standardized residuals + normal curve
stats_resid <- aug_sppsf %>%
  summarise(
    MEAN = mean(STD_RESID, na.rm = TRUE),
    SD   = sd(STD_RESID,   na.rm = TRUE),
    N    = sum(!is.na(STD_RESID))
  )

mu <- stats_resid$MEAN
sd_ <- stats_resid$SD
n_  <- stats_resid$N
binwidth <- 0.25

ggplot(aug_sppsf, aes(x = STD_RESID)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = binwidth, color = "black", fill = "steelblue") +
  stat_function(
    fun = function(x) dnorm(x, mean = mu, sd = sd_) * n_ * binwidth,
    size = 1
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Histogram\nDependent Variable: LN_SPPSF",
    x = "Regression Standardized Residual",
    y = "Frequency"
  ) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = Inf, y = Inf,
    hjust = 1.1, vjust = 1.5,
    label = sprintf("Mean = %.3f\nStd. Dev. = %.3f\nN = %d", mu, sd_, n_)
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r rstats}
############################################################
# PART B: TIME-ADJUSTED MODELS, RATIOS, CLUSTERS
############################################################

# ---- 19. Helper functions for ratio stats & within bands ----

ratio_stats_single <- function(actual, pred) {
  ok <- is.finite(actual) & is.finite(pred)
  a  <- actual[ok]
  p  <- pred[ok]
  n  <- length(a)
  if (n == 0) {
    return(tibble(
      N = 0L,
      MEDIAN_RATIO   = NA_real_,
      MEAN_RATIO     = NA_real_,
      WGT_MEAN_RATIO = NA_real_,
      PRD = NA_real_,
      COD = NA_real_,
      PRB = NA_real_
    ))
  }
  r   <- p / a
  med <- median(r, na.rm = TRUE)
  mean_r <- mean(r, na.rm = TRUE)
  wgt_mean_r <- sum(p, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(a, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  # COD
  cod <- 100 * mean(abs(r - med), na.rm = TRUE) / med
  
  # PRD
  prd <- mean_r / wgt_mean_r
  
  # PRB (approximate IAAO approach)
  vproxy <- (p + a) / 2
  dev_pct <- (r - med) / med * 100
  x <- log(vproxy) - mean(log(vproxy), na.rm = TRUE)
  prb <- tryCatch({
    coef(lm(dev_pct ~ x))[["x"]] / 100
  }, error = function(e) NA_real_)
  
  tibble(
    N = n,
    MEDIAN_RATIO   = med,
    MEAN_RATIO     = mean_r,
    WGT_MEAN_RATIO = wgt_mean_r,
    PRD = prd,
    COD = cod,
    PRB = prb
  )
}

ratio_stats_by <- function(data, group_var, actual, pred) {
  gsym <- rlang::enquo(group_var)
  asy  <- rlang::enquo(actual)
  psy  <- rlang::enquo(pred)
  
  data %>%
    group_by(!!gsym, .drop = FALSE) %>%
    group_modify(~ ratio_stats_single(.x %>% pull(!!asy),
                                      .x %>% pull(!!psy))) %>%
    ungroup()
}

within_band_flags <- function(pred, actual,
                              band10 = 0.10,
                              band20 = 0.20,
                              band50 = 0.50) {
  ratio <- pred / actual
  tibble(
    WITHIN10 = if_else(!is.na(ratio) & ratio <= 1 + band10 & ratio >= 1 - band10, 1L, 0L),
    WITHIN20 = if_else(!is.na(ratio) & ratio <= 1 + band20 & ratio >= 1 - band20, 1L, 0L),
    WITHIN50 = if_else(!is.na(ratio) & ratio <= 1 + band50 & ratio >= 1 - band50, 1L, 0L)
  )
}
```

```{r datareorg}
# ---- 21. Building & lot size ratios ----

# By style: base building size
# Building size transforms: base by style, ratios, logs

df <- df %>%
  # we already filtered earlier to SINGLE FAMILY / 1/2 DUPLEX,
  # so this gives one median per style
  group_by(SRESB_STYLE) %>%
  mutate(
    BASE_BLDGSIZE = median(SRESB_FLOORAREA, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    BASE_BLDGSIZE_RATIO    = SRESB_FLOORAREA / BASE_BLDGSIZE,
    LN_BASE_BLDGSIZE_RATIO = log(BASE_BLDGSIZE_RATIO),
    # alternative centered size (like LNSBLDSFINT in SPSS)
    SBLDSFINT   = SRESB_FLOORAREA - 400,
    LNSBLDSFINT = if_else(SBLDSFINT > 0, log(SBLDSFINT), NA_real_)
  )

# By style: base lot size
# Lot size & landratio transforms: base by style, ratios, logs

df <- df %>%
  group_by(SRESB_STYLE) %>%
  mutate(
    BASE_LOTSIZE = median(STOTALSQFT, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    BASE_LOTSIZE_RATIO     = STOTALSQFT / BASE_LOTSIZE,
    LN_BASE_LOTSIZE_RATIO  = log(BASE_LOTSIZE_RATIO),
    LANDRATIO  = STOTALSQFT / BASE_LOTSIZE,
    LANDRATIO2 = case_when(
      LANDRATIO >= 0.90 & LANDRATIO <= 1.10 ~ 1,
      SRESB_STYLE != "SINGLE FAMILY" & LANDRATIO > 3 ~ 3,
      SRESB_STYLE == "SINGLE FAMILY" & LANDRATIO > 4 ~ 4,
      TRUE ~ LANDRATIO
    ),
    LN_LANDRATIO = log(LANDRATIO2)
  )

# ---- 22. CLUSTER_ID as factor ----

if ("CLUSTER_ID" %in% names(df)) {
  df <- df %>%
    mutate(CLUSTER_ID = as.factor(CLUSTER_ID))
}
```

```{r mod2}
# ---- 23. LN_PRICE model (no ECFs) & outlier flag (Cook's D + SD resid) ----

df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    LN_PRICE = log(SALEPRICE)
  )

mod_ln_price_full <- lm(
  LN_PRICE ~ LN_LANDRATIO + LN_BASE_BLDGSIZE_RATIO +
    ARTERIAL +
    SINGLE_FAMILY1STORY +
    HALF_DUPLEX1STORY + HALF_DUPLEX2STORY +
    SMALLEST + SMALL + LARGE + LARGEST +
    TWO_PLUS_BATHS + POWDER_ROOM +
    GOOD + FAIR + POOR + VERY_POOR_UNSOUND +
    QABOVE_AVG + QBELOW_AVG_POOR +
    YB_PRE_1929 + YB_1946_TO_1960 + YB_POST_1961 +
    CRAWL + SLAB +
    LN_GARAGESPACES + FIREPLACE +
    HOT_WATER + CENTRAL_AIR +
    MONTHS_6TO22 + MONTHS_23TO30,
  data = df
)

mod_ln_price_back <- stats::step(
  mod_ln_price_full,
  direction = "backward",
  trace = FALSE
)

# Outlier filter like SPSS:
# ---- Outlier filter like SPSS: Cook's D + standardized residuals ----

# Number of observations in the model
n_mod <- nobs(mod_ln_price_back)

# Get the rows from df that were actually used in the model
mf <- model.frame(mod_ln_price_back)
idx <- as.integer(rownames(mf))  # row indices in df

# Work only on those rows
df_in <- df[idx, ] %>%
  mutate(
    COOK_1 = cooks.distance(mod_ln_price_back),
    SDR_1  = rstandard(mod_ln_price_back),
    IN_FLAG = if_else(
      COOK_1 <= 4 / n_mod & abs(SDR_1) <= 2,
      1L, 0L
    )
  )

# If you want to see how many made it through:
# df_in %>% count(IN_FLAG)

# ---- 24. Final time adjustment (RATE1 & RATE2 set #2) & LN_TASP ----

# After filtering outliers
df_in <- df_in %>% filter(IN_FLAG == 1L)

time_params2 <- get_time_params(mod_ln_price_back, df_in, end = "max")

RATE1_2     <- time_params2$RATE1
RATE2_2     <- time_params2$RATE2
END_INDEX_2 <- time_params2$END_INDEX

df_in <- df_in %>%
  mutate(
    PRICE_INDEX_2 = (1 + RATE1_2)^MONTHS_6TO22 * (1 + RATE2_2)^MONTHS_23TO30,
    TAF_2         = END_INDEX_2 / PRICE_INDEX_2,
    TASP_2        = SALEPRICE * TAF_2,
    TASPPSF_2     = TASP_2 / SRESB_FLOORAREA,
    LN_TASP       = log(TASP_2)
  )
```

```{r mod2a}
    # back-transform from log if LN_SPPSF = log(SPPSF)
    PRED_SPPSF = exp(.fitted),
    STD_RESID  = .std.resid
  )

# 3) Histogram of standardized residuals + normal curve
stats_resid <- aug_sppsf %>%
  summarise(
    MEAN = mean(STD_RESID, na.rm = TRUE),
    SD   = sd(STD_RESID,   na.rm = TRUE),
    N    = sum(!is.na(STD_RESID))
  )

mu <- stats_resid$MEAN
sd_ <- stats_resid$SD
n_  <- stats_resid$N
binwidth <- 0.25

ggplot(aug_sppsf, aes(x = STD_RESID)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = binwidth, color = "black", fill = "steelblue") +
  stat_function(
    fun = function(x) dnorm(x, mean = mu, sd = sd_) * n_ * binwidth,
    size = 1
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Histogram\nDependent Variable: LN_PRICE",
    x = "Regression Standardized Residual",
    y = "Frequency"
  ) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = Inf, y = Inf,
    hjust = 1.1, vjust = 1.5,
    label = sprintf("Mean = %.3f\nStd. Dev. = %.3f\nN = %d", mu, sd_, n_)
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r mod2p}
# 4) Residuals vs MONTHS
ggplot(aug_sppsf, aes(x = MONTHS, y = STD_RESID)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5, size = 1.2) +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", se = FALSE, color = "red") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(10, 20), linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(x = "MONTHS", y = "Standardized residual") +
```

```{r mod3}
# ---- 25. LN_TASP model with clusters, backward elimination ----

    ARTERIAL +
    SINGLE_FAMILY1STORY +
    HALF_DUPLEX1STORY + HALF_DUPLEX2STORY +
    SMALLEST + SMALL + LARGE + LARGEST +
    TWO_PLUS_BATHS + POWDER_ROOM +
    GOOD + FAIR + POOR + VERY_POOR_UNSOUND +
    QABOVE_AVG + QBELOW_AVG_POOR +
    YB_PRE_1929 + YB_1946_TO_1960 + YB_POST_1961 +
    CRAWL + SLAB +
    LN_GARAGESPACES + FIREPLACE +
    HOT_WATER + CENTRAL_AIR +
    CLUSTER_ID,
  data = df_in
)

mod_ln_tasp_back <- stats::step(
  mod_ln_tasp_full,
  direction = "backward",
  trace = FALSE
)
```

```{r mod3a}
############################################################

# 1) Get the rows that were actually used by the model
mf <- model.frame(mod_ln_tasp_back)          # model frame
row_idx <- as.integer(rownames(mf))           # row numbers in df

# 2) Subset df to those rows and augment
aug_sppsf <- augment(mod_ln_tasp_back, data = df[row_idx, ]) %>%

    PRED_SPPSF = exp(.fitted),

  geom_histogram(binwidth = binwidth, color = "black", fill = "steelblue") +
  stat_function(
    fun = function(x) dnorm(x, mean = mu, sd = sd_) * n_ * binwidth,

  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r tstats}
# Predictions & ratio vs TASP_2 (ESP3 analog)
df_in <- df_in %>%
  mutate(
    PRE_3 = predict(mod_ln_tasp_back, newdata = df_in),
    ESP3  = exp(PRE_3),
    RATIO3 = ESP3 / TASP_2
  )

# Ratio stats for ESP3 vs TASP_2 by selected groups
if ("ECF" %in% names(df_in)) {
  ratio_by_ecf <- ratio_stats_by(df_in, ECF, TASP_2, ESP3)
  print(ratio_by_ecf)
}

ratio_by_SCOND <- ratio_stats_by(df_in, SCOND, TASP_2, ESP3)
ratio_by_SIZE  <- ratio_stats_by(df_in, SIZE,  TASP_2, ESP3)

print(ratio_by_SCOND)
print(ratio_by_SIZE)

# Within 10/20/50% for ESP3
within3 <- within_band_flags(df_in$ESP3, df_in$TASP_2)

within3_summary <- within3 %>%
  summarise(
    PCT_WITHIN10 = mean(WITHIN10) * 100,
    PCT_WITHIN20 = mean(WITHIN20) * 100,
    PCT_WITHIN50 = mean(WITHIN50) * 100
  )

print(within3_summary)
```

```{r mod4}
# ---- 26. Alternative size: LNSBLDSFINT & final dollar model (MODMV) ----

mod_ln_tasp_alt <- lm(
  LN_TASP ~ LN_LANDRATIO + LNSBLDSFINT +
    ARTERIAL +
    SINGLE_FAMILY1STORY +
    HALF_DUPLEX1STORY + HALF_DUPLEX2STORY +
    SMALLEST + SMALL + LARGE + LARGEST +
    TWO_PLUS_BATHS + POWDER_ROOM +
    GOOD + FAIR + POOR + VERY_POOR_UNSOUND +
    QABOVE_AVG + QBELOW_AVG_POOR +
    YB_PRE_1929 + YB_1946_TO_1960 + YB_POST_1961 +
    CRAWL + SLAB +
    GARAGESPACES + FIREPLACE +       # garage as count
    HOT_WATER + CENTRAL_AIR +
    CLUSTER_ID,
  data = df_in
)

mod_ln_tasp_alt_back <- stats::step(
  mod_ln_tasp_alt,
  direction = "backward",
  trace = FALSE
)

summary(mod_ln_tasp_alt_back)

df_in <- df_in %>%
  mutate(
    PRE_4 = predict(mod_ln_tasp_alt_back, newdata = df_in),
    ESP4  = exp(PRE_4),
    MODMV = ESP4,              # final dollar modeled value
    RATIO4 = ESP4 / TASP_2
  )

# Ratio stats & within-bands for ESP4 vs TASP_2
ratio_by_SRESB_STYLE_4 <- ratio_stats_by(df_in, SRESB_STYLE, TASP_2, ESP4)
print(ratio_by_SRESB_STYLE_4)

within4 <- within_band_flags(df_in$ESP4, df_in$TASP_2)
within4_summary <- within4 %>%
  summarise(
    PCT_WITHIN10 = mean(WITHIN10) * 100,
    PCT_WITHIN20 = mean(WITHIN20) * 100,
    PCT_WITHIN50 = mean(WITHIN50) * 100
  )
print(within4_summary)
```

```{r tadd, eval = FALSE}
# Which rows in df do the df_in rows correspond to?
id_in <- as.integer(rownames(df_in))

cols_time <- c("PRICE_INDEX_2", "TAF_2", "TASP_2", "TASPPSF_2", "LN_TASP")

# Make sure df has these columns (they’ll be created if they don’t exist yet)
for (nm in cols_time) {
  if (!nm %in% names(df)) {
    df[[nm]] <- NA_real_
  }
}

# Copy values from df_in back into df for those rows
df[id_in, cols_time] <- df_in[, cols_time]
```
